Pad 2 Snare / Secondary Percussion Tools - V1.34
  Target: Pad 2 only
  Safety: Pads 1, 3, and 4 are not touched by P2 commands

Profiles:
  P2B = load Pad 2 BD Classic rolling low percussion / home
  P2H = load Pad 2 SD Hard pressure snare
  P2C = load Pad 2 SD Classic rolling snare
  P2F = load Pad 2 SD FM metallic snare

Mutation commands for current Pad 2 profile:
  P2T = tone / snap / source discovery
  P2P = pressure / body discovery
  P2G = grit / noise discovery
  P2R = rotate Pad 2 through profiled secondary-lane engines
  P2X = safely mutate the currently loaded Pad 2 profile
  P2Z = return current Pad 2 profile to anchor

Rotation order:
  1. My BD Classic / machine CC15 value 1 < current
  2. Pad 2 SD Hard Pressure Snare / machine CC15 value 2
  3. Pad 2 SD Classic Rolling Snare / machine CC15 value 3
  4. Pad 2 SD FM Metallic Snare / machine CC15 value 14

Current Pad 2 profile:
  My BD Classic / BD Classic rolling low percussion / home
  Machine CC15 value: 1

Current Pad 2 state: not loaded yet. Use O, P2B, P2H, P2C, P2F, or P2R first.
